notes.title: Patch 0.8.0
notes.content:
Cartographer's Cove Rework - the final level now feels actually good
Credits Chasm - Credits minigame is ready, if you didn't see your name on there let me know since I based it off of leaderboards
Steam achievements available - testing achievements, you'll probably get a bunch of them off the first start of the game if you completed most things

notes.title: Playtest 0.7.0 - C for Cartographer's Cove
notes.content:
- Final level of the game is now unlockable and playable
- Leaderboard synchronization fixes

Note: while the credits mini game will load, it is not complete, so feel free to exit the level.

notes.title: Playtest 0.7.0
notes.content:
Version 0.7.0

- Final level of the game can now be unlocked and played
- Chest icons have been updated to be visually distinct
- Leaderboard synchronization fixes


Note: The credits scene will play but is not complete, feel free to exit it.

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Leaderboard Synchronization Fixes
notes.content:
An attempt to synchronize your latest local scores with leaderboards is included in this build.

Note, this build changed the internal data format, so your latest run has been lost BUT progression (things you've unlocked should remain).

Your current highest leaderboard score also remains, it is only local data that is gone.


Update accessible build to 0.6.0


Patch Notes 0.6.0

Synchronization Mechanism

Testing the leaderboard synchronization behavior which should ensure your most up to date scores end up being uploaded at some point in time when you hit the steam rate limit because you're so good, you're climbing the leaderboards too fast.

Other changes


 Screenshake when you get hit
 Death animations
 Out of oxygen effects

notes.title: PlayTest version 0.4
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0.4.1

A whole new world

The third world for the game is now accessible. 

With the inclusion of the story and adding better ordering for revealing levels, you'll have to gather at least 1 chest per level in each world to unlock the next world.

Movement Updates

Added inertia to the horizontal movement. You can go slightly faster now too.

Score Updates

Addressed feedback in regards to scoring:


 Chest quality matters now
 Not taking damage bonus calculates correctly
 Scores will be higher than before


Things in place that don't work intentionally


 While you can change the language, none of the translations are in. English is the only correct text at the moment.


Prior Playtest

A lot of the feedback from the prior playtest has been incorporated, hopefully you notice these improvements if you made suggestions.

Feedback

Feel free to leave your feedback as a thread either on the playtest app forums https://steamcommunity.com/app/2481130/discussions/ or the dedicated 0.4.x feedback forum on the game's community hub https://steamcommunity.com/app/2398370/discussions/2/

notes.title: 0.3.5 - Leaderboard Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixes problem with leaderboards only loading 5 entries for global score/time
- Fixes problem with leaderboards clearing the 2nd,3rd,4th tabs
- Removes "smart" caching of values when re-opening leaderboards (fresh load every time now)

notes.title: 0.3.2 - Remove Quit hotkey
notes.content: Removed ability to rage quit out of the game by pressing T or the B button on a gamepad.
